lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters are arranged in semi-vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The largest blobs are located mid-flank, spaced approximately 1.5 to 2 blob-diameters apart.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical striations of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary blob constellation, particularly evident in the mid-body region where blobs are positioned as central nodes within the lighter vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, dominant linear feature is observed horizontally along the upper third of the flank, manifesting as a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels above a shadow-defined lower boundary.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance spots, with approximately 5 distinct points identifiable despite the partial cropping and motion blur.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density clustering of micro-blobs, which are significantly smaller and more densely packed than the primary constellation on the lateral flank.
